proof:
classical
obtain ⟨a, ha, ha0⟩ := Submodule.exists_mem_ne_zero_of_ne_bot h_T011.2.2.2
obtain ⟨S, hS⟩ := h_T011.2.2.1
have hfinite : ((↑S : Set ℂ) \ {0}).Finite := S.finite_toSet.sdiff
obtain ⟨k, g, hg⟩ := hfinite.fin_embedding
have hspan : Submodule.span (R p) (Set.range g) = J p M (ev y v 0) := by
  rw [hg, Submodule.span_sdiff_singleton_zero, hS]
have hg0 : ∀ j, g j ≠ 0 := by
  intro j
  have hj : g j ∈ (↑S : Set ℂ) \ {0} := by
    rw [← hg]
    exact Set.mem_range_self j
  simpa only [Set.mem_singleton_iff] using hj.2
have hk : 0 < k := by
  by_contra hn
  have hk0 : k = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_not_pos hn
  subst k
  have hb : J p M (ev y v 0) = ⊥ := by
    simpa using hspan.symm
  exact h_T011.2.2.2 hb
rcases h_T012.1 with ⟨μ, hμ, hμinj, hμrange⟩
let A : ℚ ⊗[R p] J p M (ev y v 0) :=
  1 ⊗ₜ[R p] (⟨a, ha⟩ : J p M (ev y v 0))
have hA : μ A = a := by
  simpa [A] using hμ 1 ⟨a, ha⟩
have hA0 : A ≠ 0 := by
  intro hz
  apply ha0
  rw [← hA, hz, map_zero]
refine ⟨a, ha, ha0, k, hk, (fun j => g j), ?_, hspan⟩
intro j
have hgj : g j ∈ J p M (ev y v 0) := by
  rw [← hspan]
  exact Submodule.subset_span (Set.mem_range_self j)
let B : ℚ ⊗[R p] J p M (ev y v 0) :=
  1 ⊗ₜ[R p] (⟨g j, hgj⟩ : J p M (ev y v 0))
have hB : μ B = g j := by
  simpa [B] using hμ 1 ⟨g j, hgj⟩
obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := exists_smul_eq_of_finrank_eq_one h_T013 hA0 B
have hqC : q • a = g j := by
  simpa only [map_smul, hA, hB] using congrArg μ hq
have heq : g j = (q : ℂ) * a := by
  simpa [Algebra.smul_def] using hqC.symm
refine ⟨hg0 j, q, ?_, heq⟩
intro hq0
apply hg0 j
simpa [hq0] using heq
